summary: National Medical Center already has WhatsApp booking and a good set of treatments. Repeated sections, empty pages and visible typos make the site look unfinished, and there is little proof to convince a new patient.

findings.problem: Services, Why Us and Complete Dental Care each appear twice with near identical text. The Blog and FAQ show headings but no content.
findings.cost: Repeated and empty sections look unfinished and dilute your search ranking.
findings.fix: One clean page structure with real FAQ and blog content that answers what patients search for.

findings.problem: Booking is WhatsApp and phone only. The Contact us section has no form, and the footer phone (043453906) does not match your main number.
findings.cost: A visitor who prefers a form, or dials the wrong footer number, is lost without you knowing.
findings.fix: Booking form beside WhatsApp, one verified phone number everywhere.

findings.problem: Six testimonials with first names only, no stars or dates. No before and after images, no named doctors or credentials.
findings.cost: Without visible doctors and results, price decides and you lose to the cheapest clinic.
findings.fix: Doctor profiles with credentials, a captioned results gallery and your Google reviews with star ratings.

findings.problem: Typos: Satwa,UAE and confidence,Let have no spaces and the footer reads Copyright behave 2024. The page repeats best dental clinic in Dubai about seven times and uses the word cheap.
findings.cost: Typos and keyword stuffing weaken trust. Cheap positions you as low quality when you could sell on care.
findings.fix: Proofread, natural copy that sells care and results, written to rank for Satwa and Dubai searches.

redesign: A proof first homepage: named doctors, real reviews with stars and before and after cases next to every booking button.
Booking form plus WhatsApp on every page, with one correct phone number.
A page per treatment, written to rank for searches like dental veneers Dubai and dentist in Satwa.
